page.title: The Smart Builder Contract
page.topic: The Smart Builder — the Naya app builder

sections.body:
GitHub as an intelligent smart app builder. Someone says "create nayanet.live/anything" — any topic, any name — and a page gets built from finished pieces and goes live, categorized.

Not a website builder. A Naya app builder. Naya apps are mini hub portals — active, live, smart, intelligent. Web pages are done; smart apps are the future.
sections.function: states the mission: finished pieces in, live Naya app out
sections.heading: What we're building

sections.body:
Lovable, Replit, Base44, Claude, ChatGPT — they start from nothing, guess, output garbage, and the human fights for weeks or months. Ours starts from finished pieces that already work, plus a contract where intent, function, and look are specified BEFORE building.

Nothing to guess, nothing to fight. First output: beautiful AND working.
sections.function: competitive positioning — why finished pieces win
sections.heading: Why it beats everything else

sections.body:
A living form, co-crafted by both sides. The user picks pieces, switches things, types answers; Naya drafts, suggests, fills in. Molded in the open until "okay, build" fires assembly.

Images upload right in chat (like ChatGPT) and ride the contract into the build — nobody uploads twice. Links typed into the builder become contract fields. Page copy comes from talking, pasting, or dropping a doc — straight into the contract. The builder proposes the page skeleton from intent; the user approves or rearranges it. The user always sees a beautiful visual of what's going on — pieces, elements, answers, all organized.
sections.function: the intake questionnaire and living form that produces the contract
sections.heading: How it works — the intake

sections.body:
The questionnaire captures what everything DOES — intent, vision, goal, function — not just how it looks. That's the part every other builder skips.

Division of labor: the user never says what it looks like. They pick the parts and say what it DOES. Beauty is the system's job — the pieces plus the contract handle that. The system anticipates: everything is pre-done, pre-wired, pre-beautiful — the user just fills in the intent. Tell it what you intend, pick the pieces, boom, done. So beautiful, so logical, so intelligent that once you've experienced it, you can't imagine doing it any other way.
sections.function: captures intent, vision, goal, function — the part other builders skip
sections.heading: The function contract

sections.body: Searchable. Type "buttons" — all the buttons come up. Type "boards" — all the boards. Every piece carries two labels: one humans understand, one Nayas read to pull the right piece.
sections.function: search and discovery across the piece library with dual labels
sections.heading: The gallery

sections.body: Pre-made contracts — the fastest path: pick, tweak, build. Ten to start: personal page (the flagship — my world in one page: about me, social profiles, everything linked; shareable, invites people to build with me), business landing, booking, product page (not full stores — too complex, unless Shopify sync earns it later), portfolio, event, menu/price list, community hub, signup, dashboard/tracker (the one that shows off the "smart").
sections.function: one-click starts — pre-made contracts, flagship personal page first
sections.heading: Templates

sections.body:
Pages stay alive by connecting to the owner's services — Google Drive, whatever they use. The page works WITH their world, not as a dead brochure. Same connector model as mine, pointed at the page owner's world.

Template is the one-click start; connections keep it living — both ride the contract.
sections.function: keeps the page alive via the owner's connected services
sections.heading: Connected world

sections.body: Naya can run your page and your business — interactions, live conversations, mail, all automatic. AI ↔ personal app ↔ their apps, and Muse ↔ all apps — together the whole world gets automated, shared, understood.
sections.heading: Naya runs it

sections.body: It's their own world. Smart mail, spaces, all of it usable privately — nobody needs to know. Sharing to NayaNET is opt-in; then it appears on the activity feed, and the network intelligently connects like minds. It auto-organizes.
sections.function: privacy default with opt-in sharing to the network
sections.heading: Private by default

sections.body:
BUILD → SEE → LEARN → SHARE, one loop. Build with NayaNET; reports (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) show their world; the feed shows where each project stands; everything learned gets smart-noted with a smart link and shared so the whole community learns and grows.

Nobody's learning stays trapped. Every page is both the thing built AND how the network grows.
sections.function: the build-see-learn-share loop that grows the network
sections.heading: The vision loop

sections.body:
Compose, don't create. Builders compose pre-built elite pieces — never invent new ones, never even need to read the laws. Tweak freely (one-token changes, DNA intact). New pieces only through the full process.

Function law: pretty + useless = not done. Every element intentional, logical, actually works. The builder clicks everything — real behavior, not staged. Scorecards score the working page, never the screenshot.
sections.function: the compose-don't-create build discipline and the function law
sections.heading: How we build it

sections.body:
Everything we build is mobile-optimized and looks like a killer mobile smart app by default. These are smart mobile apps — PWAs. Every Naya app ships with install-app built in: download it to the phone and it works like an app right away.

The intake thinks proactively: one of the intake steps is the app icon — upload the image at the right size, or better, Naya creates the image for your page. Icon, install, mobile presentation and function are common practice, handled by default, so anyone can spin up one of these mini smart apps and it's on their phone working immediately.
sections.function: PWA installability and mobile-first defaults handled by the intake
sections.heading: Mobile-first — the default, not a feature

sections.body: Build on subdomains, never the main page. A page goes live when it scores 9+ and Shawn has looked at it — after that, updates ship automatically. Never overwrite a proven page with unproven work.
sections.function: deploy rules — subdomains, the score gate, never overwrite proven pages
sections.heading: Deploy

sections.body: Pieces organized in GitHub. Contract canonical and ratified. Every law paired with its visual example. Deploy pipeline live. Voice font picked. The smart creator page gets built only after setup is truly 10/10.
sections.function: readiness checklist that gates the exam
sections.heading: Setup 10/10 — before the exam

sections.body: The smart creator page gets built only after setup is 10/10. Then: built from existing pieces (check first — nothing invented); it must actually WORK — generates a real contract you can see and access; Shawn fills it in, picks pieces, clicks build; he says "the contract's there — build it"; the team builds the page from the contract; he judges beautiful + working on first output.
